steps.body: Multiply then subtract: build the whole from equal groups, then remove what the story takes away — once, from the total.
steps.narration: Multiply then subtract: build the whole from equal groups, then remove what the story takes away — once, from the total.

widget.prompt: Build the five tables before anything breaks: 4 chairs at each table.
widget.successFeedback: 20 chairs standing — the total the story builds before the 3 broken ones come out of it.
widget.partialFeedback: Every table holds the same 4 chairs; build each bar to 4 before any are removed.

predict.prompt: 5 tables of 4 chairs, 3 break. Is it 5 × (4 − 3)?
predict.reveal: 5 × (4 − 3) breaks three chairs at every table — fifteen in all. The story breaks exactly three.

cml.actionGoal: Build the equal-group total, then subtract one loss from the whole.
invariants: A loss stated once is removed once from the completed total, not from every group.
misconceptions: Subtracting the single loss inside each equal group.
cml.counterfactualPrompt: Which numbers would have to change for the SECOND step to become unnecessary?

Used oranges leave the total, so the final operation is subtraction.
